note: Residual-risk view per risk. Inherent scores live in data/risks.json. A residual status is only reduced where control evidence exists for the tested scope; otherwise it stays UNASSESSED. Ordinal scores are ranking aids and are never summed. No risk has been formally accepted.

treatments.residual_rationale: SC-01 to SC-05 are supported by the recorded run: local control continued and responded in both directions during the outage. Recovery understanding (SC-06) remains open via FND-REC-001, so the reduction does not extend to reconciliation.
No unexplained transition was observed in the recorded run (SC-03), but adversarial manipulation of control was not tested.
Telemetry source and timestamps were examined for the run; integrity attacks and stale-data behaviour were not tested (planned EXP-05).
IAM effectiveness was not exercised. Absence of evidence is not treated as low risk.
Connectivity and control events for the recorded run were time-orderable (SC-05); complete logging coverage was not assessed.
Provenance and pinning are evidenced. Vulnerability, licence and signing governance remain outside the implemented evidence, so the residual view is bounded.
Physical and environmental dependencies are modelled only; no physical test exists in a simulated laboratory.
Configuration is version-controlled and traceable to the recorded baseline; a change-management process was not tested (planned EXP-09).
Reconciliation evidence is the open finding FND-REC-001. Residual assessment is blocked until EXP-02 or a documented root cause.
Evidence lineage and SHA-256 integrity are implemented and continuously verified for the laboratory evidence set.
Loss of a required measurement was modelled but not injected (planned EXP-05). Controller behaviour with stale or missing meter input is unknown.
Applicability records now exist at provision level with explicit missing facts. Real oversight is absent (GAP-GOV-OVERSIGHT).
